About the arcade

Late Shift Arcade is a small, curated compendium of browser games — each one complete, quick to pick up, and built to respect a late hour. The cabinet aesthetic is real: launch a game and it plays on a CRT-style screen, scanlines and all.

AI-made, and disclosed. Every cartridge here ships with a material, disclosed AI contribution to its design, code, art, audio, or testing. Human editing is expected; the disclosure is the point.

There are no accounts and no tracking. High scores are stored in your browser and never leave your device.

Late Shift Arcade — small games for the small hours. Every cartridge is AI-made and human-edited.
